claims.claim: A single-threaded blocking server on tiny_http with no async runtime starts almost instantly
claims.why: tiny_http was not measured; the closest data is other Rust servers (rust-actix 239 ms, rust-axum 238 ms start-up), which points the same way but can't confirm tiny_http's figure.

claims.claim: The tiny_http + serde_json server should use a few MB of RAM
claims.why: tiny_http was not benchmarked; the measured Rust servers (actix and axum) used 1 MB idle and 3–10 MB peak, which agrees with the claim but doesn't measure it.

claims.claim: Streaming firmware uploads to disk rather than buffering keeps memory under 20 MB
claims.why: None of the benchmarks tested large uploads or streaming, so memory during a firmware upload can't be checked.
